description: Xtra Power Screwdriver Bits Combination Set, Ph2, 65mm/100mm, 3 Pieces - Distributed/Packaged by Xtra Power. Product Details: The Xtra Power Screwdriver Bits Combination Set is a practical addition to your toolkit, designed for versatility and convenience. This set includes 3 pieces of Ph2 (Phillips head size 2) screwdriver bits in two different lengths: 65mm and 100mm, giving you options for various applications and access requirements. The longer 100mm bit is particularly useful for reaching recessed screws or working in tight spaces where standard bits fall short, whilst the 65mm bits offer excellent control for general-purpose fastening tasks. Manufactured by Xtra Power, these bits are built to handle regular drilling and driving operations. The Phillips head Ph2 size is one of the most commonly used screw head types, making this set suitable for furniture assembly, appliance repairs, electrical work, and general household maintenance. Whether you're a DIY enthusiast or a professional tradesperson, having multiple lengths of the same bit size ensures you're prepared for different job requirements without switching between tools constantly.
